notes: Seed $220M (May 2024), formerly Holistic AI; TechCrunch lists VCs Accel, Bpifrance Large Venture, Creandum, Elaia, Eurazeo, FirstMark and Visionaries Club plus billionaires/family offices and strategics (Amazon, Samsung, UiPath); no lead named. About 40% equity, the rest convertible debt (TechCrunch citing Bloomberg), so no priced post-money: no valuation recorded. Visionaries' thesis names the DeepMind founding team (Wierstra, Sifre, Perolat, Tuyls, Kantor); per Maddyness (2026-09-07) that entire founding team has now left: three co-founders early, CEO Charles Kantor ousted mid-2025, CTO Laurent Sifre to Microsoft in 2026, and Kantor launched a new neocloud startup (Sifted headline 2026-09-30). Company operating (Holo4 open-weight models, 2026-09-28/29). Matches the Creandum and Accel siblings (Seed, Paris, no later round). Founded: Maddyness says the founders left 'just two years after its creation' (Sept 2026), i.e. 2024; TechCrunch: seed came 'a few months after the company's inception'.
